verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's docs describe each sandbox as an "isolated cloud computer." The ability to run a Docker daemon inside a sandbox hints at VM-like separation, but the docs never name the isolation mechanism or describe it as a hard boundary. Network policy and credential-injection features are adjacent controls and earn no credit here. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the isolation technology (microVM, gVisor or equivalent), description of the kernel/hypervisor boundary and threat model, independent or hands-on corroboration of isolation strength.
